title: Lock on the paper rail with state notes
spec: Add src/payer/lock.ts: lockForAcceptor({ state, accept, rail, notes, postDeal, signer }) applies the accept, writes the tclk state note "accepted" (ifAbsent), calls rail.lock(lockTerms(state)), posts the lock frame through postDeal (deal room, board fallback), advances the state note to "locked <ref>" with CAS, and returns { state, ref, surface }. Any throw before the lock frame is posted must leave the rail without a lock (call order: rail.lock last before the post is NOT acceptable — lock the rail, then post; if the post fails, refund is the caller's job and the function rethrows with the ref attached).
done: On the fixture the note store shows accepted→locked, the rail holds the lock, and the lock frame validates.
